s.note: the battle on the plains of Wakanda
s.how: Grind 80g roasted peanuts with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground ginger, chilli flakes and salt. Coat 500g thinly sliced rump and thread onto skewers. Grill hot and serve with sliced red onion and tomato.

s.n: School bus ham and cheese pizza scrolls
s.note: Peter on the school bus over Queens
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 400g self-raising flour, then mix in 250ml milk to a soft dough. Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 3 tbsp tomato paste, scatter with 150g chopped ham, 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Lay in a lined tin, cut side up, and bake at 210C for 20 minutes until golden.

m.note: Thanos resting on his farm at the very end
m.how: Soften an onion with 2 tsp cumin. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 2 tins chickpeas and a tin of tomatoes with 500ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 100g baby spinach and serve with warm flatbread. A simple meal, perfectly balanced.

w.how: Make up 3 packets of jelly in red, orange and green as the packets say, then set three more colours, each 250ml liquid with 2 tsp gelatine dissolved in: apple juice for yellow, grape juice for purple and butterfly pea tea for blue. Pour each into a glass over matching fruit: raspberries, mango, green grapes, tinned pineapple, purple grapes and blueberries. Chill 4 hours. Top with 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.how: Peel and chop 1 pineapple and blend with a 5cm knob of peeled ginger, the juice of 2 limes, 3 tbsp honey and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain through a sieve, pressing on the pulp. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses of ice, top each with a splash of soda water and garnish with mint and a pineapple wedge.
